title: 0202 - A1 lane: the (1e7, 3.19e7] gap CLOSED - the local DN census now covers [14, 3e10] end-to-end; the running-max ladder theorem lands in W2Beyond4, and the data's first wiggle is named
body: The one region the 0201 census did not cover locally - (1e7, 3.1946e7], 52,290,633 zeros - was NOT newly computed: it was ALREADY ON DISK as the LMFDB/Platt .dat shard stream of item 4.3 (2026-09-14/22; /tmp/zeta-dl/shards; 11 shards (8.846e6, 3.1946e7]; 104-bit delta format per convert_hi3e10.py). Censused it (tmp/a1_gap_census.py -> tmp/a1_gap.out, 24s single-threaded): every zero absolutely indexed by the exact per-block Nt headers - no frontier constant at all. INTEGRITY, every gate OK: N(1e7) read from the shard stream = 21,136,125 (certified LMFDB count); N(3.1946e7) = 73,426,758 TRIPLY CONFIRMED (the shard stream itself, the 0201 chained anchor from the certified D seam, and the 2026-09-14 manifest Nt0); the overlap (8.846e6, 1e7] agrees with the independent LMFDB 1e7 pull element-wise to two ULP over 2,611,739 zeros; census zero count = N(end) - N(1e7) exactly. MEASURED: sup|DN| = 2.188682735 at t = 30,461,845.49; min = -0.951425716 (positive-side dominance persists); q50 = 0.625040; q99.999 = 1.949706; P(|DN|>2.4) = 0. THE FINDING BEYOND COMPLETENESS: the per-bin sups are NOT monotone - the first measured WIGGLE under the envelope: sup(1e7,2e7] = 2.175625149 > sup(2e7,3e7] = 2.149216451, back up to 2.188682735 on (3e7,3.19e7]. The running maximum sup_[14,T] nonetheless grows strictly at every coarse decade: 2.1101 < 2.1887 < 2.2969 < 2.3773 < 2.4387 < 2.5030 < 2.5539 < 2.6151 (span < 1). W2Beyond4 (0202 update, targeted + full tree 17450 jobs green): three new K defs (K_1e7_2e7, K_2e7_3e7, K_3e7_32e7), K_pins_rational extended, ladder_running_max and ladder_wiggle theorems (the honest shape: the envelope grows, the bins fluctuate O(0.03-0.05)), header data table + ledger section 8 updated (173.9 billion zeros end-to-end), PLAN item 8 restated. The data-free |DN| <= K theorem - still the single named open one - now has its target shape quantified from the data: a non-constant, o(log), INCREASING ENVELOPE (drift ~0.15/decade at the measured scale) with O(0.03-0.05) bin-scale fluctuations. No RH claim: record and shape work on the data side of the named open clause.
